frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Sornette's self-organized-criticality / phase-transition mechanism for fat tails: slow build-up of long-range correlations among imitating traders drives imitation strength K toward a critical value K_c where cluster size diverges and a coordinated sell-off becomes possible, making the trigger secondary to the unstable critical state, per Sornette (2017) Ch.1 and Ch.5.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Crashes as Endogenous Critical Points: Imitation, Herding, and the Order-Disorder Transition
